question: What purpose is served by performing the rite at the root of an aśvattha tree?
premises: The rite may be performed at the root of an aśvattha tree.
This location is associated with prosperity of all desires.
inference: Performing the rite at the aśvattha root brings prosperity in all desires.
plain_english: And at the root of an aśvattha tree, for the prosperity of all desires.
